title: Az őszirózsás forradalom (1918) (Revolution in Budapest)
grammar: Past Conditional Volna in Historical Context, War Obligation & Epochal Connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the Aster Revolution of 1918 and name Mihály Károlyi.
I can say what would not have happened otherwise in 1918, using volna.
I can use the words for the soldiers' council, the armistice and the proclamation of the republic.
I can read a short account of October and November 1918 and answer questions about it.
